name: route-replanning
title: Deliver a parcel, replanning when a road closes

origin.source: Plan-execute-replan over a graph the machine traverses itself

comparison.purpose: A plan is a prediction, and the world gets a vote. The machine plans the whole route by traversing itself with xstate/graph, then drives it one leg at a time with no model call and no recomputation. When a leg reports a closed road the plan is dead: the closure joins the world, the route is recomputed from where the courier is standing, and the run carries on. Contrast river-crossing, whose closed world means one plan always holds.
